exposure: continuous insulin pump therapy with CGM
outcome: glycemic control (CGM metrics, HbA1c levels, TIR, TAR, TBR)
neonatal outcomes (birth weight, length, health status)
cohort: The study involved a 33-year-old pregnant woman with a 23-year history of type 1 diabetes mellitus.
finding: The advanced hybrid closed-loop system improved glycemic control during pregnancy, but optimal control also critically depended on accurate carbohydrate counting, specific timing of insulin doses, and dietary choices.
